cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(demo C)
set(CMAKE_C_COMPILER clang)
set(CMAKE_LINKER_TYPE LLD)
set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "${CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS} -fuse-ld=lld -Wl,--icf=all -Wl,--gc-sections")
add_executable(demo src/main.c src/util.c)
target_link_options(demo PRIVATE "-Wl,-Map,demo.map" "LINKER:-z,now" "LINKER:SHELL:--time-trace --as-needed")
set_target_properties(demo PROPERTIES LINKER_TYPE LLD)
add_library(util SHARED src/util.c)
target_link_options(util PRIVATE -Wl,-z,pack-relative-relocs -Xlinker --color-diagnostics -Xlinker --hash-style=gnu)
